entities.summary: Alice Bah Kuhnke is a politician for the Green Party who is currently a Member of the European Parliament since 2019. Previously she served as the Minister of Culture and Democracy from October 2014 to January 2019. Before going into politics, she was a television presenter. She also helped found the think tank Sektor3.
